recommendation.diagnosis: Fulfilment delay before hand-off to carriers
recommendation.diagnosis_detail: Disputes are 6.2x the 30-day baseline and 88% are item-not-received. Disputes are spread across 4 carriers (top carrier 34%) and the median time to ship is 62h. Parcels are leaving late, so the problem is upstream of the carriers.
